annotations.title: Get market movement for a company

description: Recent activity among companies adjacent to the one given: who raised, hired, won a contract, filed or expanded in their market. Returns dated events with the shared market themes they were matched on, for opening outreach with a market update rather than a pitch. Costs one call from the daily API quota, and returns few or no rows when little has happened.

company.description: Company id or slug of the RECIPIENT, i.e. who you are writing to

lookback_days.description: How far back to look for market movement (default 90)

name: get_market_gift
